title: Employment Security Act of 1980
source_id: Okla. Stat. tit. 40, secs. 1-101 et seq.
verified_how: queried the Legislature's own statute search (Title 40, SearchText 'Employment Security Act of 1980'): 46 current sections carry the Act's name, across its article-style numbering (among those returned: 40-1-108, 40-1-210, 40-2-303, 40-2-411, 40-2-506, 40-2-607, 40-2-618, 40-3-106, 40-3-203, 40-3-511, 40-3-702, 40-4-109, 40-4-504). 'Title 40 - Labor' confirmed on the titles index, currency 'last updated on November 18th, 2025'.
notes: Unemployment compensation: eligibility, benefit amount, disqualification and employer contributions. Means-tested public assistance sits in a different title, Okla. Stat. tit. 56 (Poor Persons), which was confirmed to exist on the titles index but is not listed because only one statute per topic is recorded. Section catchlines were not read.
